results.statement_short: If an actual physical cross block has S=||M||F^2, c=||M||op^2, rho=min(max row norm^2,max col norm^2), S>2c and S-2c>=(9/2)rho, then ||p_Q||inf <=(9sqrt(3)e/2)[S(S-c)(S-2c)/6]^(-1/6), with continuous C0 density.

A rank-k repeated spectral projection packet with small physical leverage supplies a random coordinate cut satisfying the cross-energy gate; rank-6 leverage 1/6 gives coefficient 28.86895/|beta|, and a rank-8 leverage-1/8 packet tolerates arbitrary-rank cross operator perturbation |beta|/32 with coefficient <25.943/|beta|.

On a protected physical core, only the number K_theta of hostile added compression eigenvalues above theta times the surviving gap is charged; their magnitudes are arbitrary and the remaining hostile cloud may have arbitrary rank.

partner_result_applied.equation_use: Set k=K_theta, so beta_(k+1)<=theta g and L>= (1-theta)g; substitute into the partner density inequality.
